topics.headline: VIX to exceed 3-month avg in 30 days
topics.summary: Latest VIX close sits well below its recent average, anchoring the comparison baseline for the 30-day-ahead question. FRED VIXCLS series confirms recent closes in the mid-teens, enabling exact 63-day average computation near 16. Brent crude remains elevated on Middle East supply risks, a priced geopolitical factor that can reprice equity vol higher. WTI settlement reflects ongoing Hormuz-related disruptions that historically correlate with VIX spikes. VIX futures for October settle above spot, embedding a modest contango that prices some rise over the next month. Long-term VIX average near 18-20 underscores current levels as low, raising odds of upward reversion versus the 3m mean.
